findings.evidence: docs/managed-rollout.md:108 and design.md decision 6 say pre-seeding the answers makes rollout render an equivalent workflow without conflict. However, design.md:8 identifies the existing edit as `runs-on: alters`, while template/.github/workflows/dev-platform.yml.jinja:26 now renders `runs-on: "alters"`. Copier must replay the downstream ubuntu-latest→alters edit onto a target that independently changes that same line to quoted alters. Guarded recovery in scripts/rollout_project.py:1413–1431 accepts only baseline-equivalent or narrowly reclaimed conflicts; the hand-edited workflow differs from its old baseline. Even if replay preserves the unquoted line, template/scripts/platform_doctor.py rejects it because it compares against json.dumps('alters'). The migration tests pre-seed answers but never reproduce the existing workflow edits (tests/test_ci_runner_selection.py, CiRunnerMigrationTests.migrate), so they do not cover the promised transition.
findings.summary: Recording runner answers alone does not enable the promised migration of existing hand-edited workflows.
